assessment_objectives.objective: business-critical data requiring redundant copies is identified and documented.
redundant copies of all business-critical data are maintained within one (1) or more logically vaulted or offline environments.

logically vaulted or offline environments are isolated from the primary processing environment such that a compromise of production credentials or systems cannot modify or delete the redundant copies.
the frequency at which redundant copies of business-critical data are updated is defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least weekly, or more frequently as required to meet Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs)

assessment_objectives.objective: redundant copies of business-critical data are verified for completeness and recoverability at a defined frequency and the results are documented.
